item.name: Module 1 - question sets
M1-01 List my question sets - 200
M1-02 Create a question set - 201, owner is the caller

exec: pm.test("host_id is the caller, not 99", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().host_id).to.not.eql(99); });

item.name: M1-03 Title too short - 400 VALIDATION_FAILED
M1-04 Title and description of the wrong type - 400

M1-06 Nobody (no X-Demo-User) - 401 AUTH_REQUIRED

M1-08 Read one of my sets - 200

exec: pm.test("it is the set I made", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("setId"))); });

item.name: M1-09 Set that does not exist - 404
M1-10 The id is not a number - 400

M1-12 Another host reads my set - 403 FORBIDDEN
M1-13 Update one field - 200

exec: pm.test("title changed, description kept", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.title).to.eql("Renamed By Collection"); pm.expect(j.description).to.eql("created by the collection"); });

Module 2 - game sessions and players
M2-01 Start game A - 201, server makes the code
M2-02 Question set of another host - 403
M2-03 Question set that does not exist - 404
M2-04 Wrong type for question_set_id - 400
M2-05 question_set_id larger than the column - 400, never 500
M2-06 A player starts a game - 403
M2-07 Read a game by its code - 200
M2-08 A code that no game uses - 404
M2-09 Code that is not six digits - 400
M2-10 Code that starts with 0 - 400
M2-11 Join game A - 201, new seat
M2-12 Join again - 200, same seat (rejoin)

exec: pm.test("rejoined with the same player_id", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.rejoined).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.player_id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("seatId"))); });

item.name: M2-13 Rejoin with another nickname - still the same seat

exec: pm.test("same seat, found by account not nickname", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().player_id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("seatId"))); });

item.name: M2-14 Nickname already used - 409 NICKNAME_TAKEN
M2-15 Nickname too short - 400
M2-16 Join without X-Demo-User - 401
M2-17 Join a game that does not exist - 404
M2-18 List the players of a game - 200, no private data

exec: pm.test("Mara is in the list", function () { pm.expect(list.map(p => p.nickname)).to.include("Mara"); });

pm.test("no school_id, email or full name leaks", function () { const text = JSON.stringify(list); pm.expect(text).to.not.include("school_id"); pm.expect(text).to.not.include("email"); pm.expect(text).to.not.include("full_name"); });
